task: Surface a truncated/finish_reason indicator on chat thoughts and workflow-drawer states via a new shared TruncationBadge component, driven by backend Thought/state fields.

component_scope.label: XXL
component_scope.affected: TruncationBadge (new shared component), Thought/ThoughtHeader (extracted), CodeBlock (headerBadge prop), ChatAiMessage, WorkflowDrawerList/WorkflowDrawerListItem, WorkflowStateOutput, ContinueWithInputPopup, WorkflowExecutionEditOutputForm, chatGeneration store, workflowExecutions store, conversation/workflow type definitions, chatHelpers utils, workflows constants
component_scope.layers: Shared UI component library, Chat page layer, Workflow drawer/states layer, Valtio store (service) layer, Type definitions, Utils

requirements_clarity.label: M
requirements_clarity.gaps: Design iterated during implementation per commit history: headerBadge added to CodeBlock/Thought first, then extracted into a shared TruncationBadge component, then wired to drive off Thought fields, with a final commit syncing spec/plan docs to the shipped drawer/chat design after the fact — indicates the final shape was not fully settled up front.

technical_risk.label: S
technical_risk.risk_factors: Extends the existing streaming thought-merge logic (_handleThought in chatGeneration.ts) with two new optional fields (finish_reason, truncated); modifies shared components (CodeBlock, Thought) reused across both chat and workflow-drawer surfaces
technical_risk.mitigation: New fields follow the exact existing field-merge pattern used for interrupted/aborted/routing; TruncationBadge renders null when not truncated, so the change is additive and backward compatible; no security or performance-critical path involved

key_reasoning.reason: Touches core shared UI components (new TruncationBadge abstraction, Thought/ThoughtHeader split, CodeBlock headerBadge prop) that are reused across both the chat and workflow-drawer subsystems, plus the store/service layer (chatGeneration, workflowExecutions) and shared type definitions — a red flag for touching core shared utilities bumped this from XL to XXL (capped).

35 files changed per diffstat (22 modified, 13 new), which crosses the 16+ threshold for XXL — though a meaningful share of that count is test files and run-tracking docs following an established plumbing pattern rather than novel logic.
